partners.mechanism_chain: TGIF1 (HGNC:11739) —DISRUPTS→ Embryonic development signaling (GO:0009555); Embryonic development signaling (GO:0009555) —LEADS_TO→ Holoprosencephaly (HP:0001290); APC (HGNC:549) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:P000000001); CTNNB1 (HGNC:2515) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:P000000001); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:P000000001) —LEADS_TO→ Colorectal cancer (MONDO:0005575). Loss-of-function mutations in TGIF1 disrupt embryonic signaling pathways leading to holoprosencephaly. Simultaneously, loss-of-function mutations in APC and CTNNB1 disrupt the Wnt signaling pathway, a key regulator of cell proliferation and differentiation, leading to colorectal cancer. The convergence is on the Wnt signaling pathway, which is critical for both normal development and tissue homeostasis, and its dysregulation contributes to both diseases.

partners.mechanism_chain: TGIF1 variant (LOVD:TGIF1) —DISRUPTS→ TGIF1 (HGNC:11571); TGIF1 (HGNC:11571) —DISRUPTS→ Embryonic development (GO:0009887); Embryonic development (GO:0009887) —LEADS_TO→ Holoprosencephaly (HP:0001290); SERPINE1 variant (LOVD:SERPINE1) —DISRUPTS→ SERPINE1 (HGNC:10561); SERPINE1 (HGNC:10561) —DISRUPTS→ PAI-1 activity (GO:0033722); PAI-1 activity (GO:0033722) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency (MONDO:0013227); Embryonic development (GO:0009887) —DECREASES→ PAI-1 activity (GO:0033722). Simultaneously, loss-of-function mutations in APC and CTNNB1 disrupt the Wnt signaling pathway, a key regulator of cell proliferation and differentiation, leading to colorectal cancer.
